channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TSE rejeita pedido de grupo da Espanha para observar eleições de 2026
item.description: The TSE rejected the accreditation request of the Eurolat Global Democracy Forum to observe the 2026 elections, stating the entity does not meet the technical requirements for international electoral observation missions. The decision was based on the lack of ties to recognized institutions, absence of an electoral mandate or governmental endorsement, and identification of members linked to figures critical of Brazil's electoral system, such as the former Maldives vice-president convicted of corruption.

item.title: Jerônimo chama fala de Caiado sobre baianos de "ofensiva e infeliz"
item.description: Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) denounced as offensive and unfortunate remarks by presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), who said Bahians would feel 'freed' if he and ACM Neto (União Brasil) won the 2026 elections. Jerônimo emphasized that Bahia’s people are free, descended from Black and Indigenous communities, and rejected the notion that they need emancipation. He linked Caiado and ACM Neto to bolsonarismo and noted their technical tie in the Genial/Quaest poll for the state governorship.

item.title: Milei é como Nero, gosta de incendiar relações, diz analista argentino
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei was compared to Emperor Nero by an Argentine analyst for his public attacks on Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, which triggered a bilateral crisis between Brazil and Argentina. Milei’s statements, including insults and unfounded accusations, were seen as a deliberate effort to deteriorate diplomatic relations between the two nations.

item.title: Indecisão de Cleitinho e medo de governar: o que fez candidatura ao governo de Minas emperrar mesmo liderando pesquisas
item.description: Cleitinho, a senator from the Republicanos party, is facing an impasse in his pre-candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais: while his party announced his candidacy, he himself declares he will run, but electoral law prevents him from changing parties now. His hesitation stems from fear of governing a state with severe fiscal crisis and uncertainty about allies like Nikolas Ferreira.

item.title: Lula pede apoio de prefeitos para enfrentar o El Niño
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva urged Brazilian mayors to support federal efforts to mitigate the impacts of the El Niño phenomenon, emphasizing their local knowledge of vulnerabilities. He announced a R$1.335 billion package for prevention actions, including data unification, risk mapping, and protection of vulnerable populations, focusing on drought in the North and Northeast and floods in the South. Minister of Civil House Miriam Belchior proposed a teleconference with all 5,569 mayors to engage them in implementing the plan.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral pelo Brasil: exposição no Amazonas celebra os 30 anos da urna eletrônica
item.description: The exhibition '30 years of the Electronic Ballot: The evolution that strengthens democracy', organized by the TRE-AM at Shopping Manaus Via Norte, celebrates 30 years of Brazil's electronic voting system. The display features historical ballot box models, original documents, and photographs, allowing the public to experience the evolution of voting from canvas boxes to the current electronic system, including an interactive vote between 'Technology' and 'Nostalgia' options.

item.title: Rejeição alta, aprovação de Tarcísio e estagnação: as más notícias da Quaest para o início da campanha de Haddad
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Fernando Haddad (PT) with 58% rejection and stagnant voting intentions at 26%, while Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) rises to 41% and maintains 55% approval. Haddad’s campaign struggles with no growth despite the official start of the race, contrasting with 2022 when he led with over 40%.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: Tarcísio abre 15 pontos sobre Haddad e venceria no primeiro turno
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading Fernando Haddad (PT) by 41% to 26% in the first round and 48% to 32% in the second, with 57% of valid votes projected for Tarcísio — enough to win in the first round. His approval rating stands at 55%, and 55% of voters support his re-election, indicating consolidated support and low electoral volatility.

item.title: Congresso do Paraguai repudia Lula por fala sobre a Guerra da Tríplice Aliança
item.description: The Paraguayan Congress issued a condemnation of President Lula over his remarks about the War of the Triple Alliance, accusing him of distorting and minimizing the historical conflict. The statement claims Lula’s comments disregard the severity of the war, which had devastating consequences for Paraguay.

item.title: Programa de crédito de Lula para motoristas de app não emplaca
item.description: President Lula urged faster implementation of the Move Brasil credit program, financed by BNDES, Caixa Econômica Federal, and Banco do Brasil, targeting app-based drivers, taxi drivers, and delivery workers. Despite the push, the program has failed to gain traction, facing low uptake and operational hurdles. The meeting included government ministers, highlighting the administration’s focus on the initiative.

item.title: Chanceler argentino reforça que Milei apoia Bolsonaro, mas minimiza crise com Brasil
item.description: Argentine Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno downplayed diplomatic tensions with Brazil following Javier Milei's insults toward President Lula, stating that institutional relations will not be severed. He reiterated Milei's support for the Bolsonaro family and noted that Argentina's government views the world differently from Lula's. Quirno also said he expects the Brazilian ambassador to Buenos Aires to return to resume the bilateral commercial agenda.

item.title: Após PL aceitar Canella para preservar aliança no Rio, Flávio veta mãe como suplente e evita associação ao aliado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro vetoed his mother, Rogéria Bolsonaro, as a substitute for Márcio Canella (União Brasil) in the Rio de Janeiro Senate race, despite the PL maintaining support for the ticket to preserve the alliance with the União Brasil-PP federation. The move aims to distance the Bolsonaro surname from Canella’s weakened candidacy following his arrest for illegal firearm possession, with Flávio also avoiding public appearances alongside the candidate. Rogéria will now run for federal deputy, with the PL expecting her to surpass 100,000 votes and become a key vote-getter for the party.

item.title: Tarcísio celebra pesquisas: “Retrato do reconhecimento a um governo que trabalha”
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) celebrated poll results showing him leading the 2026 gubernatorial race with a wide margin over former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT), according to surveys by Instituto Paraná and Quaest. He framed the results as recognition of his administration’s work.

item.title: PT pede ao TSE remoção de vídeo de IA de Flávio pilotando caça ao lado de Milei
item.description: The Brazil of Hope federation (PT-PCdoB-PV) filed a representation with the TSE against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) over an AI-generated video showing him piloting a fighter jet alongside Argentine President Javier Milei. The federation claims the content constitutes illegal electoral exploitation and requests its removal.

item.title: A tentativa fracassada de ex-chefe da PRF de diminuir pena
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes rejected a request by former PRF director-general Silvinei Vasques to reduce his 24-year-and-six-month sentence for involvement in the 2022 election coup plot. Vasques' defense argued for sentence reduction based on his work as municipal secretary in São José (SC) and doctoral studies in Mexico, but Moraes ruled these activities occurred while he was free under precautionary measures, not in state custody, thus ineligible for remission. Vasques was convicted for his role in PRF roadblocks that disrupted voting in the Northeast during the 2022 presidential runoff.

item.title: Os pontos das pesquisas em SP comemorados pela campanha de Tarcísio
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas' pre-campaign celebrated poll results from Paraná Pesquisas and Genial/Quaest showing stable and growing leads over Fernando Haddad, with advantages of 13.4 and 15 points respectively in the first round. High approval ratings for his administration (63.8% in Paraná Pesquisas and 55% in Genial/Quaest) are seen as potential to convert support into votes, especially with the start of electoral advertising and greater TV time. Campaign allies believe the lead could increase further after electoral propaganda begins.

item.title: Cotada a vice de Flávio, aliada de Michelle diz que não foi procurada
item.description: Fortaleza city councilor Priscila Costa (PL-CE) stated she has not been approached by the PL leadership to be the running mate for presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), emphasizing her full focus on running for federal deputy in Ceará. Although her name was mentioned after Centrón parties signaled neutrality, she denied any discussions about the vice-presidential role and said it is not her current political goal.

item.title: Ao vivo: TCU analisa determinações sobre a concessão da Malha Oeste
item.description: The TCU is reviewing the determinations regarding the concession of the Malha Oeste Railway, whose current operator, Rumo, chose not to renew its contract, which expired in 2026. The federal government plans to auction the railway in the third quarter of 2026, but the process is stalled due to documentation deemed insufficient by the TCU, which has requested additional information before assessing the new tender. The hearing is taking place live on Wednesday, July 29, 2026, at 2:30 p.m.

item.title: Mulher Segura: governo conta mais de 15 mil prisões em julho
item.description: The federal government reported 15,428 arrests in domestic violence cases from July 1 to 27 under Operation Mulher Segura, a significant increase from the 6,328 arrests in the first phase (February 19 to March 5). The Integrated Women’s Safety Center (CIMS), launched in March 2026 in Brasília, centralizes security data to combat gender-based violence and operates under the National Pact Against Femicide, with support from First Lady Janja da Silva and Lula’s ministers.

item.title: Após ataques de Milei, chanceler descarta romper relações com Brasil
item.description: The Argentine government ruled out breaking diplomatic relations with Brazil despite President Javier Milei's criticisms of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno stated that ideological differences between the leaders will not affect institutional ties between the two countries. Milei, who attended a PL event and supports the Bolsonaro family, continues to share criticisms of Lula on social media, keeping the diplomatic climate tense.

item.title: Governo libera R$ 1,4 bilhão e monta plano contra avanço do El Niño
item.description: The federal government released R$1.4 billion to address El Niño impacts, including emergency works, disaster prevention and expanding stocks of rice and corn through Conab. The measure aims to reduce shortages and contain food price increases, disaster prevention and expansion of public rice and corn stocks via Conab. The initiative seeks to prevent food shortages and curb inflation in basic food prices, amid forecasts of above-average rainfall in the South and droughts in the North and Northeast. The announcement was made by Minister Miriam Belchior following a meeting chaired by President Lula.

item.title: Chanceler argentino diz que não há chance de rompimento com Brasil e cita futebol
item.description: Argentine Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno stated there is no chance of a diplomatic rupture with Brazil, despite Javier Milei’s attacks on President Lula and Minister Alexandre de Moraes. He emphasized that tensions remain confined to the political and ideological sphere, with no intent to escalate to institutional or economic levels. Quirno also expressed hope for the swift return of Argentina’s ambassador to Brazil and denied having evidence that criticism of Argentina’s 2026 World Cup team was funded by Brazil.

item.title: Lula lança plano contra El Niño e diz que país está “preparado”
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva launched on July 29, 2026, the national plan for prevention and mitigation of the impacts of El Niño 2026/2027, allocating R$ 1.335 billion. The plan, based on four pillars — data unification, risk mapping, anticipatory actions, and protection of vulnerable populations — involves 24 ministries and six federal agencies, including the establishment of an El Niño Situation Room. Lula stressed the federal government’s preparedness and the need for cooperation with governors and mayors to address expected regional impacts: drought in the North and Northeast, delayed rainfall in the Center-West and Southeast, and above-average rainfall in the South.

item.title: Nacionalização da disputa pode favorecer candidato na Bahia, avalia cientista político
item.description: The race for governor of Bahia is technically tied between ACM Neto (União Brasil) and Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT), with 39% and 38% in first-round voting intentions, according to the Genial/Quaest poll. Political scientist Elias Tavares argues the outcome will hinge on the campaign's level of nationalization: a more state-focused race favors ACM Neto due to his local experience and voter familiarity, while a more nationalized, polarization-driven campaign benefits Jerônimo by leveraging the PT’s electoral strength and Lula’s influence. Jerônimo also holds an incumbent advantage, having governed since the last election, unlike his first run.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro vai reforçar a Moraes que ex-presidente não sabia de vídeo de IA em convenção de Flávio
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro informs Minister Alexandre de Moraes that the former president had no prior knowledge of the AI-generated video shown at the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy, asserting the initiative came solely from the son's campaign and the party. The response aims to avoid allegations of violating precautionary measures, as Bolsonaro is barred from political-electoral acts, directly or through third parties. If Moraes finds authorization occurred, it may constitute a new breach; otherwise, responsibility could fall on Flávio's campaign and the PL for unauthorized synthetic content, prohibited under electoral law.

item.title: Remoção de posts em 24h e combate a deepfakes: os critérios do TSE em casos envolvendo IA
item.description: The TSE is enforcing stricter rules for AI use in electoral propaganda ahead of the 2026 elections, emphasizing the removal of deepfakes within 24 hours and holding candidates and platforms accountable. Recent decisions include injunctions ordering the removal of manipulated content, such as a deep fake simulating Jair Bolsonaro’s voice at a PL event, and the court is evaluating AI detection tools as supplementary evidence, not sole basis for rulings.

item.title: Ministros do TSE veem abuso em vídeo com Bolsonaro e querem frear uso exagerado de IA em campanhas
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is evaluating whether the use of an AI-generated avatar of Jair Bolsonaro in a PL party convention video, urging votes for his son Flávio Bolsonaro, constitutes an electoral abuse. Three ministers were consulted: two see abuse, citing violations of norms prohibiting IA use to favor candidates and early vote solicitation; one argues it's permissible if no disinformation or harm is involved. If condemned, the penalty would likely be a fine and content removal, not candidacy cancellation.

item.title: Lula também apagou o governo no jingle
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign released a version of the Rap do Silva that highlights his humble origins as a Brazilian worker and family man, but barely mentions his actions during his third presidential term. The only reference to his current government is superficial, lacking detail on policies or achievements. The focus is on personal narrative, not governmental record.

item.title: Lula é multado em R$ 15 mil por campanha antecipada para Tebet e Marina
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) fined President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) R$ 15,000 for premature campaigning, after he urged votes for Simone Tebet (PSB) and Marina Silva (Rede) before the official election period began. The ruling, signed by Judge Ronnie Herbert Barros Soares, partially granted the request from the Missão, though the original action sought additional penalties. The case underscores the TRE’s strict enforcement of electoral laws against early campaigning, even when involving high-profile figures.

item.title: Cientista político vê um possível efeito negativo para Flávio na ‘vitória antecipada’ de Tarcísio
item.description: Political scientist Elias Tavares argues that an early victory for Tarcísio de Freitas in the first round of São Paulo's gubernatorial election could reduce voter turnout in the subsequent presidential runoff, harming Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. He notes that the lack of competitive candidacies beyond Tarcísio and Haddad turns the state race into a de facto second round in the first round, reflecting national polarization. This dynamic previously benefited Tarcísio in the last election, tied to Jair Bolsonaro's influence.

item.title: Zema pretende intensificar presença na campanha de governador de Minas Gerais
item.description: Former governor Romeu Zema intends to deepen his involvement in the campaign of Mateus Simões, his successor and political protégé, to strengthen voter support for the PSD candidate in Minas Gerais.

item.title: El Niño: governo prevê gastar até R$ 1,3 bilhão para enfrentar secas, chuvas intensas e incêndios
item.description: The federal government announced an investment of up to R$1.3 billion to mitigate the effects of El Niño in Brazil, including droughts, heavy rains, and wildfires. The plan involves 24 ministries, purchasing food supplies such as corn and rice, distributing basic food baskets, strengthening firefighting efforts, and monitoring water levels, with coordination with municipal mayors for localized implementation.

item.title: Caiado critica Flávio por se apoiar em Milei e Bolsonaro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for relying on external figures such as Javier Milei and an AI-generated avatar of Jair Bolsonaro during the PL convention, claiming it shows a lack of protagonism and moral independence. Caiado stated that leaders must build their own authority and not rely on third-party support, especially from foreign leaders or artificial representations. Gilberto Kassab, Caiado’s running mate, called the Argentina-focused debate a 'lamentable squabble' that harms bilateral relations.

item.title: TRE-SP multa Lula por propaganda antecipada e manda tirar vídeo do ar
item.description: The São Paulo Electoral Court fined President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva R$15,000 for premature electioneering after he stated in an official event, streamed on his YouTube channel, that the public could 'give their vote to the two' Simone Tebet and Marina Silva. The judge ruled the phrase, despite the 'one day' qualifier, constituted an explicit call for votes before the official campaign period. Tebet and Silva were cleared due to lack of evidence they knew or participated in the speech's preparation.

item.title: O candidato que pode ameaçar Flávio Bolsonaro na direita, segundo cientista político
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party candidate, appears with 7.8% in voting intentions, surpassing Ronaldo Caiado and Romeu Zema, and stands out as a potential threat to Flávio Bolsonaro on the right. According to political scientist Elias Tavares, his growth indicates he is no longer a virtual candidacy and could attract voters dissatisfied with bolsonarism, fragmenting the right-wing vote and benefiting Lula.

item.title: STF questiona uso de 'deepfake' de Jair Bolsonaro em campanha presidencial de Flávio
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) has requested explanations from former President Jair Bolsonaro regarding an AI-generated deepfake video in which a digital replica of him appears to endorse the presidential candidacy of his eldest son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, for the October elections. The use of deepfake technology in political campaigns raises concerns about misinformation and public opinion manipulation.

item.title: Aliado de Cunha, articulador de Zema e histórico de rompimentos: quem é Marcelo Aro, favorito para palanque de Flávio em MG
item.description: Marcelo Aro, former federal deputy and political operative linked to Eduardo Cunha and Romeu Zema, is emerging as the leading candidate to head Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket in Minas Gerais for 2026, following fallouts with allies like Alexandre Kalil and being passed over for Zema's vice-presidential slot. His career includes supporting Dilma Rousseff's impeachment, leading the FMF, and serving in Zema's Civil House before resigning to pursue a majoritarian candidacy.

item.title: Governo Lula anuncia plano de R$ 1,3 bi para prevenção do El Niño
item.description: The Lula government announced a R$1.335 billion plan to prevent and mitigate the impacts of El Niño in 2026, focusing on grain purchases, wildfire suppression, and food basket distribution. The initiative involves 23 ministries and six agencies, featuring a newly created El Niño Situation Room structured around four pillars: data unification, risk mapping, anticipatory action, and protection of vulnerable populations. Priority is given to high-risk areas in the North and Central-West, including Pará, Mato Grosso and Tocantins.

item.title: RENAN SANTOS vs TODO MUNDO! COMO o MISSÃO está VIRANDO O JOGO das ELEIÇÕES 2026
item.description: The video titled 'RENAN SANTOS vs EVERYONE! HOW MISSION IS TURNING THE TABLES IN THE 2026 ELECTIONS' suggests a political narrative of conflict surrounding Renan Santos' candidacy, portraying him as a challenger against a broad array of opponents, likely established figures. The term 'MISSION' appears to be a slogan or movement tied to his campaign, indicating an effort to mobilize popular support or launch an insurgency against the current political status quo.

item.title: Maioria desaprova decisão de Moraes que impediu Flávio de visitar o pai, aponta Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on July 23 reveals that a majority of Brazilians disapprove of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes' decision to prohibit Senator Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting former President Jair Bolsonaro for a 90-day period. The ruling was deemed inappropriate by most respondents, indicating public perception that the measure was excessive or politically motivated.

item.title: Se El Niño for grave, estamos preparados; se não for, valeu a intenção, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil is prepared to face the effects of a severe El Niño in the second half of 2024, citing investments in disaster prevention and response. If the phenomenon does not intensify, he said it was still 'worth the intention,' emphasizing the government's proactive stance. The remarks were made in Brasília on March 29 during a press briefing on climate adaptation policies.

item.title: Caiado critica Milei e IA de Bolsonaro em convenção de Flávio
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Javier Milei's participation in the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, as well as the use of an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro at the event, stating the absence of proposals and the presence of an 'avatar' and an Argentine made the event 'crude'. He also argued that political focus is shifting to external issues, such as tensions with the United States involving Argentina, rather than national debates.

item.title: “Não há chance de rompimento” com o Brasil, diz chanceler argentino
item.description: Argentine Foreign Minister Pablo Quirno stated there is no risk of a diplomatic rupture with Brazil, despite President Javier Milei's insults toward Lula during a PL event in São Paulo. He framed the incident as part of a broader history of political and ideological differences between the two nations and defended Milei's participation as personal support for the Bolsonaro family, not an institutional act. Argentina will not respond to Lula or his ministers' statements.

item.title: Proximidade de novo ministro das Relações Exteriores do Peru com EUA preocupa Brasil
item.description: The appointment of Carlos Espá, a former journalist and Peruvian presidential candidate, as Peru’s new Foreign Minister by the conservative government of Keiko Fujimori, has raised concerns in the Lula administration due to his perceived closeness to the United States. Brazil fears this alignment could undermine regional coordination and South American interests in areas such as trade integration and an independent foreign policy.

item.title: Ministério recomenda veto a trechos de projeto que cria piso mínimo do frete para caminhoneiros
item.description: The Ministry of Transport recommended a partial veto to the Civil House on the Bill of Conversion concerning the minimum freight floor for truckers, proposing the removal of six provisions, including amnesty for fines related to post-2022 election roadblocks and changes to the CLT, ANTT, and CTB. Senate government leader Randolfe Rodrigues had already anticipated that Lula would veto the amnesty clause. The justification states the provisions are unrelated to the freight floor and could undermine ANTT’s regulatory authority.

item.title: Caiado diz que Flávio Bolsonaro perdeu para argentino e avatar na convenção do PL: ‘Nível rasteiro’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD presidential pre-candidate, criticized the PL convention featuring Flávio Bolsonaro as 'low-level', claiming it focused on international attacks and AI-generated imagery of Jair Bolsonaro instead of presenting the candidate's actual views. He and his running mate Gilberto Kassab said the event abandoned societal expectations, turning politics into spectacle. Caiado also opposed penalizing AI, advocating for criminalizing misuse of technology while upholding copyright protections.

item.title: Governador da Bahia reage à declaração de Caiado sobre 'alforriar' estado caso seja eleito: 'Ofensivo e infeliz'
item.description: Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) condemned presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado’s (PSD) use of the term 'alforriar' to describe liberating Bahians, calling it offensive and hurtful, especially given his Afro-Indigenous heritage. Jerônimo emphasized Bahia’s history of resisting slavery and authoritarianism, and linked Caiado and ACM Neto to Bolsonarism despite their current critiques. A Genial/Quaest poll shows a technical tie between Jerônimo and ACM Neto in the race for Bahia’s governorship.

item.title: Petista é confrontado por assentados após chamar Bolsonaro de “canalha”
item.description: State deputy Zeca do PT from Mato Grosso do Sul was confronted by settlers from the Assentamento Mutum in Ribas do Rio Prado after calling former president Jair Bolsonaro a 'scoundrel' during a speech. Protesters reacted with outrage, challenging his harsh language and defending Bolsonaro, who is imprisoned following Lava Jato convictions. The incident underscores Brazil's deep political polarization and tensions between Lula and Bolsonaro supporters in rural areas.

item.title: Sabemos separar as coisas, diz Marina Silva sobre ofensas de Milei
item.description: Marina Silva criticized Javier Milei's insults against Lula and the Brazilian Presidency, stating they do not affect Brazil-Argentina relations because 'we know how to separate things'. Milei's remarks, made at the PL convention in São Paulo, included calling Alexandre de Moraes 'bald trash' and coining the term 'risk Lula', escalating diplomatic tensions that have existed since his inauguration in December 2023.

item.title: Como a campanha de Tarcísio reagiu aos novos números da disputa em São Paulo
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas leads voting intentions in São Paulo with advantages of 13 and 15 points over Fernando Haddad, according to surveys by Instituto Paraná Pesquisas and Genial/Quaest. His campaign attributes the lead to public recognition of his administration’s achievements and plans to intensify pre-campaign activities starting in August, traveling across the state to listen to voters and present proposals.
